name: Escape Baby Bobby Daycare! (FIRST PERSON OBBY)
desc:
Are you ready to jump into Baby Bobby's Daycare? Let's get to it! This daycare isn't like the others, it is patrolled by a GIANT BABY and has some of the world's best security technology designed to stop you from escaping! Make your way through jumps, chases, and defeat Baby Bobby in an epic boss battle. Let's do this!

If you have fun please thumbs-up 👍 and favorite ⭐ to support the game. Thank you so much for playing!

Premium players get a free speed coil to use in game!
